reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A9BD1 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A9BD1-Camera_ApplyWideScreen_17.cpp at sha256 4748e02182acb84b9080145cd969b1e4434980670f1927ff3be718bc65ccb27b (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t Camera_ApplyWideScreen_17(long param_1);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_ApplyWideScreen_17
retail_function.summary: Six blocks 0x4A9BD1-0x4A9C0x: x87 comparisons of st0 against the constants at 0x00544572 and 0x005445xx, frndint/fcompp/fnstsw flag handling and conditional clamps; the function consumes st0 and returns an int.

candidate_function.summary: Six blocks 0x4A9BD1-0x4A9C0x: x87 comparisons of st0 against the constants at 0x00544572 and 0x005445xx, frndint/fcompp/fnstsw flag handling and conditional clamps; the function consumes st0 and returns an int.

divergences: st0 input replaced by a stack long double.
Return value is the packed status word, not the clamp result.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

Six blocks 0x4A9BD1-0x4A9C0x: x87 comparisons of st0 against the constants at 0x00544572 and 0x005445xx, frndint/fcompp/fnstsw flag handling and conditional clamps; the function consumes st0 and returns an int.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0): one x87 input, no stack arguments. The candidate int _isintTOS(long double context) takes a stack long double and returns the status word — different entry class and return value.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: BN int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0): one x87 input, no stack arguments. The candidate int _isintTOS(long double context) takes a stack long double and returns the status word — different entry class and return value.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 6 block(s)/7 edge(s) at 0x004A9BD1; radare2 recovers the identical 6 block(s)/7 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 6 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Constants at 0x00544572 (and the block's 0x4A9BF6/0x4A9BF7/0x4A9BFE targets); frndint/fcompp/fcomp flag bits.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: One global read near 0x00544572; no writes.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The function is pure x87 comparison/clamp on st0; the candidate's roundl()/status-word model on a stack long double does not reproduce it.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0)" at 0x004A9BD1; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a9bd1 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A9BD1 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t Camera_ApplyWideScreen_17(long param_1);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
